name: 2026-11-09-locomotive-config-check
description: One bounded run of the locomotive from its saved config, with no release-ramp override in the environment (ASSEMBLY_RELEASE_RAMP_S and the legacy DOG_RELEASE_RAMP_S both unset with env -u), to show the 0.5 s release comes from the config's controller block (the console's 'controller settings' line reports release_ramp_s 0.5). Breakage on. Every other setting is the controller default, which is stricter than the verification sweep: a gripper contact fails the run (ASSEMBLY_GRIPPER_CONTACT unset, i.e. 'fail') and the final hold is 10 s (ASSEMBLY_HOLD_S unset). A single completed run is not evidence of numerical robustness.
invocation: env -u ASSEMBLY_RELEASE_RAMP_S -u DOG_RELEASE_RAMP_S OMNI_KIT_ACCEPT_EULA=YES DISPLAY=:1 .venv/bin/python -m experiments.ur5e_structures.run_sweep experiments/ur5e_structures/sweeps/2026-11-09-locomotive-config-check.json
